verdict.rationale: The marketing site lists framework logos under "built for your agent's context": LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, Pydantic AI, smolagents and Google ADK. It also claims Mirrors works with traces teams already have, which suggests some integration path. But this is only a logo strip with no documentation of how instrumentation works, and the OpenAI SDK and Vercel AI SDK named in the story are absent. missing for 10: documented integration/setup guides, OpenAI SDK support, Vercel AI SDK support, details of how traces are ingested, independent or hands-on corroboration.
